pull_data – Pull Data Pipeline

src/flask_website/pull_data.py – the script the Pull Data button runs in a background subprocess.

pull_data._standardize_with_llm(cleaned_rows)[source]

Adds llm-generated-program / llm-generated-university to each row in place (plus the other typed fields llm_standardize._clean_row derives: date_added, status, gpa, gre*, us_or_international, degree), by running each row’s “program” string through the local LLM.

Calls the model once per distinct program string and fans the cached result out to every row that shares it – the same dedup strategy llm_standardize.py’s own CLI path uses, since GradCafe data is full of exact repeats. If the model can’t run at all (e.g. no network for the first-run model download), this still calls _clean_row() with an empty standardization result for every row, so the non-LLM fields (date/status/gpa/…) are derived either way – only llm-generated-program/-university end up empty for this run.

Parameters:

cleaned_rows (list[dict])

Return type:

None

pull_data._to_applicant_row(row)[source]

Convert one row – already run through clean_data() and then _standardize_with_llm() – into Applicant column kwargs, or None if it’s missing a required (NOT NULL) field.

Parameters:

row (dict)

Return type:

dict | None

pull_data._load_rows(session, rows)[source]

Bulk-insert rows, skipping any whose url already exists. Returns the number of rows actually inserted (i.e. genuinely new).

Parameters:

rows (list[dict])

Return type:

int
